Browsing, copying, moving and deleting files on your TV or USB storage requires file access.\nChoose Allow file access to continue. Android 11 and later will try to open the system All files access settings. You can also cancel and enable access from the home screen later.

Your TV does not provide or allow opening the standard All files access page.\nOpen app settings and look for All files access or file management permission for TV Finder. Media read permission alone is not sufficient.\nIf no matching switch exists, this firmware may not support granting access through its interface. Keep the Device info details for further diagnosis.
